notes.subject: לאל
notes.rationale: Palo ya 408 e šomišwa bjalo ka lefoko fela mo go Jobo 24:25 — 'go se loka / phetheho' kgathanong le go gana go bonolo; ba fetoleli ba fapana: 'nothing worth' (KJV), 'of no value' (Geneva)

notes.subject: אפו
notes.rationale: 'ga jaana / bjale' — nako goba pontšho; e ka ba 'e sego bjalo ke eng?' bjalo ka Geneva

notes.subject: go bao ba reng
notes.rationale: Jobo o botša ba reng kgotso, o hloka motho yo a ka ganago — potšišo yeo e laedišago batho botlhe

translation: Gomme ge e sego bjalo ga jaana, ke mang yo a ka mpontšha e le motho wa mafele, gomme a bea lentšu la ka la ⟨go se loka⟩?

tokens.gloss: yo a ka mpontšha e le motho wa mafele
